tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: The patient shows elevated NT-proBNP, suggesting possible cardiac dysfunction or heart failure. HbA1c is high, indicating suboptimal glycemic control (diabetes). Mild anemia is present (low hematocrit, low iron), with normal ferritin and iron saturation. Total protein and CO₂ are slightly low. Liver and kidney function are within normal limits. No acute myocardial injury (normal troponin). Overall, findings suggest chronic heart failure, diabetes, and mild normocytic anemia; clinical correlation and further evaluation are recommended.
